name: section
useFor: Use SiteSection for each band of the page and SectionHeading to open it. Pick width medium (800px) for features, pricing and questions, wide (1200px) for a table, the steps or the closing card. Add bottom padding only to the section that closes the page.
constraints: Left-aligned section titles over centered content
Two tinted sections in a row
documentation:
`SiteSection` props: `ground` ("white" | "mist", default white), `width` ("wide" | "medium", default wide),
`contained` (default true), `innerClassName`, plus section props. `SectionHeading` props: `title`, `description`,
`eyebrow`, `as` ("h1" | "h2" | "h3", default h2), `align` ("center" | "start"). `Eyebrow` takes paragraph props.
title: Section
description: Page section with generous air above, the centered section heading and an optional label.
